description: Implementation of the TTSURLConstructer class responsible for constructing Text-to-Speech service URLs, handling both HTTP GET and POST requests, sanitizing input strings, and managing interactions with external TTS services in a C++ codebase.

classes.name: TTSURLConstructer
classes.description: Class responsible for constructing URLs for TTS requests, handling both online and offline speech synthesis, sanitizing input strings, and performing HTTP requests.

methods.name: constructURL
methods.description: Creates the appropriate URL based on configuration, input text, and connection status.

methods.name: httpgetURL
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP GET request URL for TTS service, including parameters like voice, language, speed, and text.

methods.name: httppostURL
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the TTS service endpoint with JSON payload and processes the response URL.

methods.name: replaceIfIsolated
methods.description: Replaces instances of a search string with a replacement string only if they are isolated by punctuation or whitespace.

methods.name: isSilentPunctuation
methods.description: Checks if a character is a silent punctuation (e.g., '?', '!', ':', etc.) that can be ignored or sanitized.

methods.name: replaceSuccesivePunctuation
methods.description: Removes multiple successive punctuation characters from a string, cleaning up the text for speech synthesis.

methods.name: curlSanitize
methods.description: Uses libcurl to URL-encode a string for safe inclusion in URLs.

methods.name: sanitizeString
methods.description: Performs multiple string replacements and sanitizations to make input text suitable for TTS requests.
